text:
maya patel: Quick sync please 1 - need to lock the timeline for the GatewayHub + LangChain + LlamaIndex co-demo and marketplace push. partner legal insists on an embargo for Wed morning.

jon becker: Clarify: embargo covers the partner announcement, marketplace listing, and sample app?

maya patel: yes, all of it. GateHub wants their adapter in the store, LangChain wants a runnable example, LlamaIndex wants a sample index + similarity output included.

samira rao: STATUS: LlamaIndex requested that the eval include three real-world prompts and a doc-level similarity score. can do if we get the sanitized dataset.

liam chen: infra note 1 - we need a short-lived staging cluster with quantized runtimes. kai, can ops spin one up?

kai nguyen: I can provision a preview pool (2xA100 equiv) for 24h. need a KIRA ticket with runtime config: model=redwood-gpt-13b-q4, kv_cache=true, prefix_cache=on, max_seq=2048.

maya patel: owners: jon -> sample app + chain example; samira -> LlamaIndex eval harness + prompts; liam -> KIRA ticket + staging; olivia -> marketplace copy & embargo paperwork.

jon becker: I'll prepare a Python/Chainlit sample that demonstrates tool-calling via the GatewayHub adapter and outputs similarity scores in JSON. target: push to preview env Mon AM.

samira rao: I'll assemble three prompts, run baseline comparisons against prod, and include quality/regression numbers. aim Mon AM results.

liam chen: creating KIRA-4628 now for the preview pool. once approved I'll attach access details.

kai nguyen: pool requested. when it's ready I'll run a quick throughput pass and share p50/p95. recommend a fallback route to hosted small-model if preview quota hits.

olivia park: legal: embargo requires exact partner quotes and logo permissions. need marketplace copy draft by EOD Monday for review.

deploy-bot: Preview environment provisioned: preview-gatewayhub-2026-04-12 1 URL: https://preview.redwood.ai/preview-gatewayhub-2026-04-12

jon becker: pushing the sample app now to the preview URL. will include instructions and a small README.

samira rao: LlamaIndex asked for an embedded doc similarity column. jon can you add that to the demo output?

jon becker: yes, adding a "similarity_score" field. also will include a short snippet showing how to compute it client-side.

liam chen: early smoke results on preview pool: 180 rps sustained, p95 ~120ms with the quantized runtime. attaching logs to KIRA-4628.

maya patel: good progress. quick blockers callout 1 please reply with one-line blockers for the partner preview meeting.

jon becker: blocker: need eng-runtime to merge GatewayHub adapter fix (PR #990).

samira rao: blocker: need sanitized seed docs from legal/olivia to build the index.

liam chen: none from infra once KIRA-4628 is active.

kai nguyen: ops: propose a rate-limit rule (50rps) on the preview route and a fallback to hosted-7b if quota exceeded.

olivia park: legal: can approve sanitized dataset. will upload to shared drive and tag the team. marketplace copy draft in progress.

maya patel: Consolidated action items:
- Jon: sample app + similarity_score -> push to preview (Mon AM)
- Samira: eval harness + baseline runs -> post results (Mon AM)
- Liam: KIRA-4628 -> staging pool (in progress)
- Kai: perf smoke & fallback rule -> report after pool ready
- Olivia: marketplace copy + embargo docs -> draft (EOD Mon)
- Maya: schedule partner preview call Wed 10am PT (pending Olivias copy)

maya patel: default: if all items clear by EOD Monday we go into embargo prep; otherwise reschedule. thanks everyone :pray: 

jon becker: ack :thumbsup:

samira rao: ack

liam chen: ack

kai nguyen: ack

olivia park: ack

maya patel: adding minimal marketplace checklist for editors:
```
- Partner logo + trademark permission
- Preview sample app link
- Eval results table + notes
- API example + SDK snippet
- Embargo date/time + approved quotes
```

maya patel: I'll drop the calendar invite after olivia confirms the copy. ping in-thread for urgent updates.
